document: Alone Against the Tide Solitaire Adventure by The Lakeshore (Call of Cthulhu MPRG 23174) (Nicholas Johnson, Lynne Hardy, Mike Mason etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You are through with this place. You want nothing more to do 
with Esbury, and whatever business you intended to carry out 
here is no longer worth your time. You gather your things and 
set out into the fog.

You keep up a brisk pace as you stride through the darkness 
and the mist. You move with all due haste, winding your way 
down streets and through alleyways as you make for the edge 
of town.

Suddenly, something reaches out and grabs your arm, 
wrapping it tightly in a vicelike grip. You panic and try to 
pull away.
• Make a STR roll: if you succeed, go to 183; if you fail, go to 199.
